verdict.rationale: Lium has no built-in natural-language command interface of its own. It does ship first-party agent-facing artifacts: an official agent skill (lium-skill SKILL.md) and agent docs stating an agent can sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods with no browser. Its MCP server answers natural-language-style queries, but only for doc search and live GPU prices and availability, not for pod operations. missing for 10: native NL command interface, MCP or agent tooling covering full pod lifecycle operations, hands-on corroboration that agent-driven NL operation works end to end.
